programs.title: Casey Anthony: Killer Mom?
programs.desc: On July 15, 2008, 911 operators receive a call about a missing girl.Orlando police are on the lookout for two-year-old Caylee, but it seems the child's mother, Casey Anthony, is trying her best to hamper the investigation.Her case sparks outrage across the United States.The creators of the program present interviews with the missing person's grandparents, Cindy and George Anthony, look at the next stages of the investigation and observe the functioning of a dysfunctional family.The series will also include reconstructions and a look at the court hearing that shocked America.Many lies were exposed during this case.
